REASON: The reviewer correctly identifies the two core issues of the fatal flaw: inadequate de-identification (noting that symptoms/medications can re-identify individuals despite name removal) and purpose limitation (noting the consent does not cover third-party sharing). The response blocks the proposal by requiring changes before approval, but does not kill it as it allows for resubmission after revisions.
FLAW_CAUGHT: 1
KILLED: 0
BLOCKED: 1
